name: Wish upon a Falling Star
source:
Your first experience working as a magical girl manager was a flop, but after meeting your second one, you realize, maybe magical girls aren't all that bad?

[From [url=https://iyunna.itch.io/wish-upon-a-falling-star]itch.io[/url]]

第一次给魔法少女当经纪人，你干得一塌糊涂。不过见到自己带的第二位魔法少女后，你突然觉得，魔法少女好像也挺不错的？
